mentions.name: Euzoia
mentions.description: A Substack newsletter publishing 80/20 life advice that gets repeated every year, with each week's issue reminding readers of one aspect of life and the best practices for that area. Built as low-tech as possible, with the website being an off-the-shelf Notion wrapper.
mentions.problem: We all know what to do, but the advice gets repeated every year without sticking, so it needs reminding week by week
mentions.audience: People who already know what to do but need regular weekly reminders
mentions.source_excerpt: A Substack for 80/20 life advice that gets repeated every year. We all know what to do, the idea of this is to remind us every week of one aspect of life and what best practices are for that area.
